observation1.comments:
First, start doing a weekly look ahead: look at the schedule for the coming week so you can prepare materials, tools, or spaces before anyone has to ask you.
Second, I'm giving you the One Small Fix Challenge: over the next 30 days, find one minor workflow bottleneck in your routine and bring me a suggestion on how to streamline it.

observation2.comments:
Daily Routine & Checklist: I recomend you start using a daily physical checklist at your workstation. Use the First 10 / Last 10 Rule: 10 minutes at the start of your shift to plan your routine, and 10 minutes at the end to confirm everything got done.
Written Logs : Ensure all your written reports and notes follow a clear 3 part format: What was done, What is pending, and Next action steps.
